name: Milford Road Course (unofficial)

location._note: Centroid of the traced lap. The course sits in the SE corner of the Milford Proving Ground (Hickory Ridge Rd east, Commerce/Duana south), Oakland County side of the county line.

source._note: Traced 2026-10-28 off USDA NAIP 2022-08-16 (0.6 m native; tile m_4208327_ne_17_060_20220816), exported from the USGS NAIPImagery ImageServer as an EPSG:4326 north-up clip, bbox -83.6700,42.5630,-83.6570,42.5770 at 2130x3112 (0.5 m/px) = source/naip_2022_mrc.jpg. Paved surface classified by colour, centre line found by a centre-seeking shortest path between hand-placed waypoints (source/trace/F1.json), re-centred and width-measured by perpendicular scans every 2 m. Widths clamped 9-16 m (median 11; the west front straight 16). Tree-shadowed pavement on the east side added by colour (source/trace/shadow_patch.py). Re-run: source/trace/README.md. OSM has this course as highway=raceway (ways 72577419 + 72577413 + connectors) but its outer loop is mis-drawn ~190 m south of the asphalt, so OSM is topology only (L1). Identification: relief along the trace 39.7 m vs the SAE paper's 41 m; length 4,072 m vs GM's '2.9 mi' (4.67 km), -13 %, see source/route-notes.md.

road_profile._doc: No banking authored (L10). Deck follows bare-earth 3DEP; any real cross-slope comes from lidar sections, never from curvature. The lap IS banked: 1 m lidar sections read -4.3 % in the esses (s 620), -7.1 % at the U-turn (s 780, the likeliest Carousel), +8.0 % at s 995. Tried 2026-10-28: scripts.elevation.crossfall (measured, 6 % cap, 80 % of the lap banked) made drive_test WORSE than the flat deck (ground-on-top 14 -> 53, severe steps 7 -> 17, bumps 17.2 -> 89.7/km, excursion drops 31 -> 52), the ledger-0018 class (crossfall x width steps). data/crossfall.json removed; the banks are authoring work, not a flag.
road_profile._max_grade_doc: Set so it never binds (L3; Kevin: real hills are never reshaped). At the 9 % default the cap shaved the real hill: the deck sat up to 5.96 m under the lidar at the SW corner and 1.6 m in the esses, and drive_test failed on grass over the pavement lip and drops off the edge (2026-10-28). The despiked 3DEP profile climbs 26.6 % over 21 m at s 3,650 (31 % over one 3 m step): the climb from the bottom sweeper to the front straight, cut into a hillside (lidar cross-sections: ground 2-3 m lower 20 m left, 1-2 m higher 20 m right, both edges climbing with the line). The 2 m dip at s 3,605 is the service-road underpass, removed by the 33 m despike.

route._orientation_doc: Clockwise, per the OSM oneway tags on every raceway way here (unverified against onboard video). S/F on the 16 m west front straight about 2/3 of the way up, raced north; the grid sits on the ~250 m of straight behind it. The lap: west straight N -> NW corner -> right-hand hairpin off the apron -> esses south -> U-turn -> north -> east into the serpentine round the woods -> top straight E -> NE corner -> east side S -> sweeping bottom W -> SW corner. Unused pavement (later layouts over this kn5): the inner hairpin short-cut, the top-straight bypass, the SE back section + cross-connector + hook.

_terrain_note: L3b: 1.25 m as IMI. At Pueblo's 2.0 m, drive_test failed (2026-10-28): 28 grass-on-top hits at the pavement lip and 20 drops over 20 cm, all on the infield's 19-33 m corners
ui_description: Unofficial reconstruction of the Milford Road Course, Michigan: the private proving-ground road course, traced from USDA NAIP 2022 aerial imagery onto USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar (40 m of real relief, 27 % at its steepest). Clockwise. Not an official or endorsed product.
author: airoso
_ground_doc: Constructed corridor, not natural_ground (2026-10-28). Natural ground (copied from IMI) left the lidar's real banks beside the pavement unguarded: drive_test counted 31 drops over 12 cm per 0.5 m within 4 m of the edge (limit 4), worst 49 cm, because the measured-guard lip pass and the shoulder drape only run in constructed mode. The other T1 circuits (Pueblo, Aspen, High Plains) are constructed.
_install_folder_doc: tools/ship_track.sh installs under content/tracks/<install_folder> (Lariat plan A11); the previous install is parked in the archive
_ui_series_doc: Kevin 2026-10-28: 'K10 is gone. doooom.' Content Manager shows '<ui_series> - <layout name>' (tools/ship_track.sh ui_name_prefix carries the same string)
